semantics.summary: A PortPrototype variation point must not declare PostBuild variant conditions; conditional existence of ports supports preCompileTime as its latest binding time.
semantics.rationale: The explicit prohibition is observable through the VariationPoint nested below each concrete port kind, while the effective binding-time interpretation may also depend on system-condition context.

targets.evidence: For the existence of PortPrototypes only a latest Binding Time of preCompileTime is supported
In the previous three cases a Binding Time of PostBuild is supported; the PortPrototype case explicitly excludes it

verification.observability_reason: Explicit POST-BUILD-VARIANT-CONDITIONS nested under a port are fully observable and forbidden; proving an indirectly derived effective binding time can require system-condition context.

curation.notes: Compile a definitive Python rule for explicit post-build conditions. Keep indirect effective-binding-time analysis as an additional review check.
